description: This file defines a class 'FlatApply' for applying functions with non-graphable types within PyTorch FX graph framework, including utility functions for handling graphable types and a registration of constant functions.

classes.name: _ConstantFunction
classes.description: A dataclass wrapping a callable to make it a graphable constant.

classes.name: FlatApply
classes.description: A HigherOrderOperator subclass that applies functions with non-graphable types within FX graphs.

methods.name: is_graphable
methods.description: Checks if a value is an acceptable input/output type for an FX node.

methods.name: is_graphable_type
methods.description: Checks if a type is graphable.

methods.name: to_graphable
methods.description: Flattens a pytree into a list of graphable types and its spec.

methods.name: from_graphable
methods.description: Reconstructs a pytree from flattened graphable types and its spec.

methods.name: func_to_graphable
methods.description: Converts a function into a flattened, graphable form.

methods.name: is_valid_output
methods.description: Checks if an output is valid (graphable or list/tuple of graphables).

methods.name: impl
methods.description: Executes the function with unflattened args and checks output validity if specified.
